verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform that runs agents and Docker containers in micro-VMs, so attaching GPUs to those workloads is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions GPUs, accelerators, or hardware selection for agents, VMs, or computers. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach GPUs to sandboxed workloads
